title: BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2611.34862v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce BOP-Refer, the first benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D grounding of everyday and industrial objects sourced from 9 diverse BOP datasets. We pair images from these datasets with VLM-generated and human-verified referring expressions, and derive accurate ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes of the referred objects from their 3D models and 6DoF pose annotations. Our systematic evaluation of 17 frontier VLMs across the major proprietary and open-weight families (Gemini, GPT, Claude, Qwen, Gemma) shows that the best model, Gemini 4 Carbon, reaches 72.6% AP_IoU2D in 2D but only 12.4% AP_IoU3D in 3D, despite the more lenient IoU thresholds in 3D. The predicted 3D boxes are usually centered on the target objects in the image but often off in depth by more than the object's size, suggesting that metric scale estimation, which needs reliable object size priors, is currently by far the main source of error.

translated_abstract: 我们提出了BOP-Refer，这是首个针对来自9个多样化BOP数据集的日常及工业物体进行单目3D和2D定位的基准。我们将这些数据集中的图像与由视觉语言模型生成并经人工验证的指代表达配对，并从物体的3D模型和6自由度位姿标注中推导出被指代物体的精确真值3D和2D边界框。我们对主要专有和开放权重模型家族（Gemini、GPT、Claude、Qwen、Gemma）中的17个前沿视觉语言模型进行了系统评估，结果表明最佳模型Gemini 4 Carbon在2D任务中达到72.6%的AP_IoU2D，但在3D任务中仅达到12.4%的AP_IoU3D，尽管3D任务使用了更宽松的IoU阈值。预测的3D边界框通常在图像中以目标物体为中心，但在深度方向上经常偏差超过物体本身的尺寸，这表明需要可靠物体尺寸先验的度量尺度估计是当前最主要的误差来源。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个单目3D与2D物体定位基准BOP-Refer，对17个前沿视觉语言模型的系统评估表明它们在2D定位上表现尚可但在3D定位上严重不足，其核心瓶颈在于依赖物体尺寸先验的度量尺度估计。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces BOP-Refer, the first benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D object grounding, and its systematic evaluation of 17 frontier VLMs reveals that while 2D grounding is moderately good, 3D grounding remains severely limited, mainly due to metric scale estimation errors that rely on reliable object size priors.
